conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: My credit card bill’s got a ₹5,000 charge I don’t recognize! What’s this?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I’m sorry, sir. Can you share the card number and transaction date?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Ends in four four six five, from last week. I didn’t buy anything!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: It looks like a merchant error. I’ll dispute the charge and block further transactions.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Good. I’m not paying for this nonsense!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: The dispute’s filed, sir. You’ll get a refund in 7-10 days.
